property.name: config_count
property.comment: the number of configuration that use this node.

property.name: build_count
property.comment: the number of builds for this node.

query.name: node-list
query.comment: Get the list of build nodes
query.sql: SELECT node.name AS name, node.login AS login, node.os_name AS os_name, node.os_version AS os_version, node.cpu_type AS cpu_type, node.repository_dir AS repository_dir, node.kind AS kind, node.status AS status, (SELECT COUNT(config.id) FROM porion_build_config AS config WHERE config.node_id = node.id) AS config_count, (SELECT COUNT(build.id) FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.node_id = node.id) AS bld_count FROM porion_node AS node WHERE node.deleted = 0 ORDER BY node.name

query.name: project-node-list
query.comment: Get the list of build nodes for a project
query.sql: SELECT node.name AS name, node.login AS login, node.os_name AS os_name, node.os_version AS os_version, node.cpu_type AS cpu_type, node.repository_dir AS repository_dir, node.kind AS kind, node.status AS status, COUNT(distinct config.id) AS config_count, (SELECT COUNT(build.id) FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.node_id = node.id AND build.project_id = :project_id) AS bld_count FROM porion_node AS node INNER JOIN porion_build_config AS config ON config.node_id = node.id WHERE node.deleted = 0 AND config.project_id = :project_id GROUP BY node.id ORDER BY node.name
